slides.headline: Somewhere you were taught that faith means looking away from the problem.
body: That is not what was said on Sunday.

slides.headline: Faith is not denial.
body: Dr Titi Sodipo was blunt about it.
Faith does not deny the reality of what you can see.
Denial does that. Faith does something else entirely.

slides.headline: Picture a jumbo jet.
body: Gravity pulls down on it with over five million Newtons of force.
That force is real. It is measurable. It never switches off.

slides.headline: It flies anyway.
body: Because a higher force is acting on it.
Gravity is still true at 35,000 feet.
It has just stopped being the only thing that is true.
slides.kicker: Faith does not argue with the smaller truth. It knows a bigger one.

slides.headline: So you are allowed to say it out loud.
body: Nothing about the situation has changed yet.
slides.kicker: Naming it is not a lack of faith.

scripture.text: Now faith is the substance of things hoped for, the evidence of things not seen.

slides.headline: One more thing she said.
body: The Nile is the river Hebrew children were drowned in.
The Nile is also the river Moses was saved on.
slides.kicker: Same water. Two truths. God moved in the bigger one.
